title: Generate translation template from Command Palette
body:
This PR registers "Generate Translation Template" (formerly "Generate POT") command to Command Palette, which gives convenient access to generating POT files. The option will open the file dialog to pick target file, or if the file was picked previously, immediately run the template generator (a message is displayed via toaster to give some feedback).

Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10986

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00fa9b42-3c17-4149-a17c-b196973047b3

Unfortunately showing the file dialog is somewhat broken due to #114812 (for now I just force show the project settings dialog).

I also simplified CommandPalette's internal `add_command()` method. It was added before `bind()` was vararg.
